summary: AI in finance: reproducing a published machine-learning preprocessing pipeline.

sections.title: The work
sections.body: Replicated a published pipeline across 5-day and 60-day horizons. Accelerated 60-day preprocessing by approximately **25%** by reusing parsed market data and normalized price arrays.

sections.title: The paper we replicated
sections.body: Our work replicated the pipeline from **(Re-)Imag(in)ing Price Trends**. The linked paper is the reference for that work.
